title: Qwen3.6-27B W8A8 · Ascend 910B4

lede.zh: 在 512-token 输出下，DCP=2 将 250K 输入、C1 的 TPOT 从 85.0 ms 降至 58.5 ms；同一长度 C4 的 TTFT 则增加 30%。
lede.en: With 512-token output, DCP=2 reduces TPOT from 85.0 to 58.5 ms at 250K input/C1; at C4, TTFT increases 30% at the same context length.

heading.zh: 解码收益需与预填充代价一起读
heading.en: Read decode gains alongside prefill cost

intro.zh: DCP=2 在低并发时降低 TPOT，长度越长收益通常越明显；并发 4 的 TTFT 代价达到 21%–30%。输出长度从上一轮的 128 改为本轮 512，因此旧结论不能直接沿用。
intro.en: DCP=2 reduces TPOT at low concurrency, with larger gains generally at longer context. At C4, TTFT cost reaches 21%–30%. Output length is 512 in this run, versus 128 in the earlier run, so prior conclusions do not transfer directly.

note.zh: 同配置噪声复测偏差在 ±0.4% 内。矩阵并发只到 4、全程无抢占，因此测得的是固定工作量的延迟变化，不是系统饱和吞吐收益。
note.en: Same-configuration noise checks were within ±0.4%. The matrix reaches only C4 and has no preemptions, so it measures latency changes under fixed work, not saturated throughput gains.

heading.zh: DCP 在低并发长上下文点降低 TPOT；并发 4 时收益缩小
heading.en: DCP lowers TPOT at low-concurrency long-context points; gains narrow at C4

intro.zh: Qwen3.6-27B W8A8、TP8×1，输出 512；仅 DCP 取值 1 与 2 改变。DCP 的收益随上下文长度变化，但并发 4 的 250K 点不延续该趋势。
intro.en: Qwen3.6-27B W8A8 with TP8×1 and 512-token output; only DCP 1 vs 2 changes. The DCP effect varies with context length and does not continue monotonically at the 250K/C4 point.

notes.zh: 并发 1 的 TPOT 收益从 64K 的 13.8% 扩大到 250K 的 31.2%；并发 4 时 250K 收益回落至 11.0%，同时 TTFT 增加 30%。
notes.en: At C1, TPOT reduction grows from 13.8% at 64K to 31.2% at 250K. At C4, the 250K reduction narrows to 11.0% while TTFT rises 30%.

title.zh: DCP=1 与 DCP=2 的 TPOT

hint.en: Hover a point to inspect the measurement.

heading.zh: DCP 取舍取决于 TPOT 与 TTFT 的优先级
heading.en: The DCP tradeoff depends on whether TPOT or TTFT is the priority

intro.zh: 本轮对照使用固定 512 输出；低并发下 decode 收益更明显，高并发时 prefill 侧 TTFT 成本上升。测试并发最高为 4，未测系统饱和吞吐。
intro.en: The comparison uses a fixed 512-token output. Decode gains are clearer at low concurrency, while TTFT cost rises at higher concurrency. Maximum tested concurrency was 4; saturated system throughput was not measured.

notes.zh: 长上下文 + 并发不超过 2 时，本轮矩阵支持 DCP 降低逐 token 延迟；高并发且 TTFT 严格时，需评估额外首 token 时间。饱和吞吐不在本报告结论范围内。
notes.en: For long context at concurrency up to 2, this matrix supports lower per-token latency with DCP. At higher concurrency with strict TTFT targets, account for added first-token time. Saturated throughput is outside this report’s scope.

hint.en: Hover a point to inspect the measurement.

methodIntro: 相同随机种子与请求形状对照 DCP=1/2；输入长度 64K、128K、250K，并发 1、2、4。噪声底使用同配置复测。
DCP=1/2 is compared with matched seeds and request shapes at 64K, 128K, and 250K input, with concurrency 1, 2, and 4. Noise floor was checked with same-configuration repeats.

methodNotes.zh: TPOT 收益与 TTFT 成本量纲不同；是否启用需按应用的首 token 与流式延迟要求判断。
methodNotes.en: TPOT gain and TTFT cost use different units; choose based on the application’s first-token and streaming-latency requirements.

methodNotes.zh: 不把固定工作量总 token/秒称为饱和吞吐，本轮并发范围不支持该推断。
methodNotes.en: Fixed-work total tokens/s is not called saturated throughput; the tested concurrency range cannot support that inference.
